2118. Simple Calculator Using Switch Statement

50

Medium

Problem Statement
Read two integers and an operator symbol, then perform the corresponding arithmetic operation using a switch statement.

Description
Read two integers a and b, followed by a character op representing one of the operators +, -, *, or /. Use a switch statement on op to perform the correct operation (addition, subtraction, multiplication, or integer division) and print the result. Assume b is never 0 when op is '/'.
input_spec: Two integers a and b, followed by a single character operator (+, -, *, or /), all separated by spaces.
output_spec: Print the result of applying the operator to a and b.
